name: What are the first steps when considering ground-up home construction?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps when considering ground-up home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial steps involve securing financing, acquiring a suitable plot of land, and assembling your project team. This team typically includes an architect to design the home and a general contractor experienced in ground-up construction. Defining your budget and wish list early helps guide the design and material selection process. Researching local zoning laws and obtaining necessary permits are also crucial early considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: First steps include securing financing, acquiring land, and assembling your team, including an architect and general contractor.
